override.name: style_mild_5_epochs
override.description: The 5-epoch page network trained with each window's relit crops shown as another squeeze might show the same relief (dino.model.relief_style), mild: lights turned up to 30 degrees, gradient components scaled within exp(+-0.2), one of them faded in 30% of the windows, depth 0.6-1.3, blur up to 1 px, noise up to 0.02; every crop moved up to 4% of its side and, with probability 0.15, a rectangle of 3-12% of it flattened.
